args.body:
• Ironbark Tooling newsletter: this week's issue covers cold-chain logistics in 2026, linking to their blog article.
• Article "Cold-chain logistics in 2026": temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data; most savings came from fewer rejected loads, not less spoilage.
• Companion piece (registered with daniel.ferreira@northwind.example): pilots cut claims by a quarter.
args.title: Ironbark Tooling: Cold-chain logistics in 2026
